meta.name: excel-heredoc-workaround
meta.description: Create Excel files with openpyxl by falling back to run_shell with inline Python heredoc when execute_code_sandbox fails

copy.tagline: 用Python创建Excel文件，自动处理沙箱失败
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在受限环境中用Python生成Excel文件
copy.tagline_en: Create Excel files with Python, auto-handling sandbox failures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate Excel files with Python in restricted environments

howto.what: 当创建 Excel 文件时，如果内置代码执行环境失败，Claude 会自动改用命令行运行 Python 内联脚本，生成带样式（字体、颜色、边框等）的 .xlsx 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求创建 .xlsx 文件，且 execute_code_sandbox 因 openpyxl 相关错误失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个带表头和蓝色背景的 Excel 文件，内容是我的任务列表。
创建一个员工考勤表，要有边框和居中文字，用交替行色。

howto.what_en: When creating Excel files, if the built-in execute_code_sandbox fails due to openpyxl issues, Claude automatically falls back to running inline Python heredoc scripts via run_shell to generate .xlsx files with styling (fonts, colors, borders, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a .xlsx file and execute_code_sandbox fails with openpyxl-related errors.

say_en.text: Create an Excel file with headers and blue background for my task list.
say_en.note: Claude tries execute_code_sandbox first, then falls back to heredoc.

say_en.text: Generate an employee attendance sheet with borders, centered text, and alternating row colors.
say_en.note: Claude uses run_shell with openpyxl styling to produce it.
